Boston Advisors Has Decreased Its Dr Pepper Snapple Group Co (DPS) Holding by $2.07 Million; Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) Holder Tig Advisors Cut Holding by $57.13 Million as Share Value Rose
May 17, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Carl Tiedemann decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) by 40.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tig Advisors Llc sold 488,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Carl Tiedemann held 724,900 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $84.88 million, down from 1.21 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tig Advisors Llc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $36.57B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.32% or $2.53 during the last trading session, reaching $106.31. About 6.37 million shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
Boston Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc Co (DPS) by 72.34% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Boston Advisors Llc sold 21,289 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 8,140 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $790,000, down from 29,429 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Boston Advisors Llc who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.53 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $119.44. About 312,056 shares traded. Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 21.65% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.10% the S&P500.
More notable recent NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) news were published by: Nasdaq.com which released: “China Eases the Pressure on Qualcomm’s NXP Deal” on May 15, 2018, also Investorplace.com with their article: “Speculators Are Piling into Qualcomm, Inc. Stock for Two Big Reasons” published on May 14, 2018, Seekingalpha.com published: “NXP Semiconductors -4% on Q1 revenue miss” on May 03, 2018. More interesting news about NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) were released by: Streetinsider.com and their article: “China approves Toshiba’s sale of $18 billion chip unit to Bain consortium” published on May 17, 2018 as well as 247Wallst.com ‘s news article titled: “Qualcomm, NXP Merger Hits Chinese Wall” with publication date: April 19, 2018.
Tig Advisors Llc, which manages about $3.62B and $1.80 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Scripps Networks Interact In (NYSE:SNI) by 254,068 shares to 1.03 million shares, valued at $87.90M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NASDAQ:NXPI) by 970,156 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.18M shares, and has risen its stake in Eqt Corp (NYSE:EQT).
Among 28 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors NV ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 10 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 17 Hold. Therefore 36% are positive. NXP Semiconductors NV had 72 analyst reports since August 3, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Mizuho downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Thursday, November 3 report. Bernstein maintained NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) rating on Thursday, May 3. Bernstein has “Hold” rating and $11500 target. The rating was downgraded by Jefferies to “Hold” on Thursday, October 27. The firm earned “Perform” rating on Friday, October 28 by Oppenheimer. Drexel Hamilton maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Thursday, February 8 report. Morgan Stanley initiated NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) on Monday, October 12 with “Overweight” rating. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Hold” rating and $110.0 target in Friday, September 1 report. The stock of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, October 18 by Jefferies. Bernstein downgraded the shares of NXPI in report on Thursday, October 26 to “Market Perform” rating. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Pacific Crest on Friday, April 8.
Analysts await NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report earnings on August, 1. They expect $1.43 earnings per share, up 30.00% or $0.33 from last year’s $1.1 per share. NXPI’s profit will be $491.91 million for 18.59 P/E if the $1.43 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.95 actual earnings per share reported by NXP Semiconductors N.V. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 50.53% EPS growth.
Analysts await Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $1.48 earnings per share, up 18.40% or $0.23 from last year’s $1.25 per share. DPS’s profit will be $266.73M for 20.18 P/E if the $1.48 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.98 actual earnings per share reported by Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 51.02% EPS growth.
